summary: @thiennq/docs-viewer preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares preinstall: `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (`_0x`-style identifiers, string-dictionary lookups) and on `npm install` downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it, chmods the binary 0755, and invokes it against a bundled sibling `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, string-array shuffler `WV8StW`, ~1500-entry mixed numeric/string constant table, `with` blocks that defeat strict-mode JS parsers), of unstated purpose and not referenced in README or AGENTS.md. The README advertises the package as a docs viewer with a zero-dependency Node.js built-ins backend, which directly contradicts the presence and preinstall-time execution of the Bun-only obfuscated payload. The chosen runtime (Bun) combined with the misleading `math_init.js` name and heavy obfuscation systematically evades Node-based static analysis that ships with typical npm supply-chain scanners. Every consumer installing this version runs the obfuscated bundle under a freshly downloaded Bun interpreter at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
